question: Is the CD limit of detection lower than UV-vis for every strain where both are reported, and by how much?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, kind, strength, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%detection%' OR text ILIKE '%LOD%' OR text ILIKE '%limit%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, figure_id, fact_no, statement, value, unit, condition, panel FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%detection%' OR statement ILIKE '%LOD%' OR statement ILIKE '%limit%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%LOD%' ORDER BY figure_id, fact_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 52 AND 66 ORDER BY line_no

SELECT id, figure_id, fact_no, statement, value, unit, condition, panel FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%detection%' OR statement ILIKE '%LOD%' OR statement ILIKE '%limit%' OR array_to_string(printed_text, ' ') ILIKE '%LOD%' ORDER BY figure_id, fact_no
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%LOD%' OR text ILIKE '%detect%' OR text ILIKE '%limit%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND (text ILIKE '%0.0034%' OR text ILIKE '%0.0066%' OR text ILIKE '%0.0123%' OR text ILIKE '%0.0125%' OR text ILIKE '%S17%') ORDER BY id

SELECT ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'versus ([0-9.]+) \(UV',1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'LOD of OD600 =([0-9.]+)',1) AS DOUBLE), 4) AS pa_diff, ROUND(CAST(regexp_extract(c.text,'versus ([0-9.]+) \(UV',1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(c.text,'LOD of ([0-9.]+) \(CD',1) AS DOUBLE), 4) AS lm_diff FROM lines a, lines b, lines c WHERE a.id='p6.L59' AND b.id='p6.L60' AND c.id='p6.L61'

or say it without a number ("several", "a", "each")

No LOD values are reported for the other strains (E. coli, E. sakazakii, S. typhimurium, S. aureus or the others), so the comparison cannot be made for them. The per-strain LOD plots are in the supplementary Fig. S17, which is not part of this document.
